liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mind Left Body Jam** (2 reviews): Reviewer wonders if the jam contains the 'fireworks, calliopes and clowns' melody from The Music Never Stopped; The song began as a discarded part of a mid-section GSET jam before emerging fully later [17][18]
- **Big River** (1 review): The performance of Big River is highlighted as worth listening to on its own [19]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): The performance of this song, including the jam, is described as near-flawless [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-09-14.aud.sirmick.32641.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 28 songs; 213 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1974-09-14.177305.sbd.NEW.patched.flegel.flac1644**: soundboard; 25 songs; 208 min [3]
- **gd74-09-14.aud.hanno.6162.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 26 songs; 215 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the audience recording as sounding like a hand-held bratwurst microphone; The audio quality is considered quite listenable by audience recording standards for that time [9][15]
- **gd1974-09-14.philips-Schinzel.teute-greenberg.9890.shnf**: source not stated; 26 songs; 215 min; rated 3.17/5 by 6 [5]. Said about its sound: Dave Greenberg stated the master has no low end, though it can be adjusted with equalizers [5]
- **gd74-09-14.sbd.miller.30653.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 200 min; rated 3.82/5 by 11 [6]. Said about its sound: The recording sounds like an audience tape with lots of reverb, as if the band is distant; The reviewer wishes to hear Deal and Jack Straw more clearly, noting both were played well; The sound becomes quite good once halfway through the blistering performance of Scarlet Begonias [12][14][16]
- **gd1974-09-14.28353.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 13 songs; 107 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [8]. Said about its sound: The sound and mix are described as great, with good playing [11]

## Around the show

- A tour poster lists the Olympia Halle Munich date as October 12, conflicting with the actual date [15]
- The recording switches from audience to soundboard right at the peak of Scarlet Begonias [19]
- The jam is considered better than the similar one from the September 20th show [10]
- Not the premier 1974 show compared to June 18 Freedom Hall and July 19 Selland Arena [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-09-14.aud.sirmick.32641.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by SirMick; source: This a remaster of shnid 6162 [1]. Also: Sugar Magnolia was patched with a soundboard source, which was transferred to DAT [1]
- **gd1974-09-14.177305.sbd.NEW.patched.flegel.flac1644**: source: Patched soundboard by Brian Flegel [3]. Also: First set audience tracks and cuts in Weather Report Suite were repatched with the Sirmick source [3]
- **gd74-09-14.aud.hanno.6162.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Hanno Bunjes; source: Audience Recording [4]
- **gd1974-09-14.philips-Schinzel.teute-greenberg.9890.shnf**: taped by Gerhard Schinzel; transferred by Uli Teute and David Greenberg; source: MAR > CD [5]. Also: The first 1:20 of Weather Report Suite was supplied from a safety cassette due to damaged reel [5]
- **gd74-09-14.sbd.miller.30653.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [6]
- **gd1974-09-14.28353.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard - Set 2, plus Phil/Ned [8]
